$comment: Schema compatibility of every migration (docs/decisions/managed-db.md MD-01…MD-12; apps/server/src/db/compat.ts). A migration's version is schemaBase + its journal position: this chain's baseline stands for the 76 migrations of the chain before it, so it is version 77 and versions never go down (docs/decisions/report-trackers.md). readers/writers: the oldest binary schema (a migration tag) that can still read/write the schema the migration produces. Classes: expand, backfill, contract, incompatible.

0000_baseline.note: The whole schema of a new Whombat in one migration, at version 77. A database of the chain before it is refused with the release that moves it across (db/compat.ts).

0001_web_search.note: Web search's two nullable columns on burrows (docs/decisions/web-search.md); the release before it reads and writes past them.

0002_tracker_fix_release.note: A followed fix's production release (docs/decisions/report-trackers.md): one nullable jsonb column on tracker_fixes; the release before it reads and writes past it.

0003_job_result.note: A job's result as a message (docs/decisions/t3code.md): a nullable jsonb column on messages and a nullable text column on t3_watches; the release before it reads and writes past them.

0004_repo_icons.note: A repository's own icon for the Chat list (docs/decisions/chat-inbox.md): a new table repo_icons and a partial index on automation_runs.thread_root_id; the release before it never reads them.

0005_prompt_merge.note: A prompt's “Merge into main when it’s done” (docs/decisions/prompts.md): a boolean column with a default on prompts and a nullable jsonb column on t3_watches; the release before it reads and writes past them.

0006_tracker_separate.note: What a tracker offers of the part it releases on its own, and whether a followed fix changes it (docs/decisions/report-trackers.md): a nullable jsonb column on tracker_cursors and a nullable text column on tracker_fixes; the release before it reads and writes past them.

0007_own_address.note: The own address (docs/decisions/own-address.md): three new tables (the box's certificates, foreign certificates, box passkey user handles), nullable columns on appliance_passkeys and appliance_state with one defaulted switch, and an existing box marked as started with the shared route; the release before it reads and writes past them.

0008_link.note: Whombat Link (docs/decisions/whombat-link.md): a phone's own push token and the handle control gave the box for it on appliance_endpoints, and the Link stop the owner was pushed about on appliance_state, all nullable; the release before it reads and writes past them.

0009_mail_triggers.note: Mail-arrives automation triggers (docs/decisions/automation-recipes.md): two new tables mail_cursors and mail_trigger_items; the release before it never reads or writes them.

0010_dutch_voice.note: Opt-in Dutch voice (docs/decisions/desk-display-talk.md): a defaulted boolean switch and three nullable agreement columns (who, when, licence version) on voice_typing; the release before it reads and writes past them.

0011_mail_trigger_sync.note: Mail trigger activation time on automations and Message-ID deduplication on mail_trigger_items: nullable columns and a partial unique index; the release before it reads and writes past them.

0012_mail_read_failures.note: Consecutive full-read failure counts per message id on mail_cursors so unreadable emails skip cleanly after 3 attempts: one nullable jsonb column; the release before it reads and writes past it.

0013_mail_trigger_attachments.note: Ready attachment ids handed over from matched incoming emails on mail_trigger_items: one defaulted text[] column; the release before it reads and writes past it.
